Validates that backlog items trace to milestones. Outputs unlinked items and can
optionally fix them.

Audit checks:
  - Detect backlog items without milestone_refs
  - Detect backlog items without priority_plan_ref
  - Use --fix to apply a default milestone
  - Use --default-milestone to specify the milestone ID for --fix

  Check milestone associations
  zqk system audit-milestones
  Fix unlinked items
  zqk system audit-milestones --fix --default-milestone MIL-123

Usage:
  zqk system audit-milestones [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string             Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --default-milestone string   The milestone ID to use when fixing unlinked items (e.g., MIL-triage)
      --fix                        Fix unlinked items by associating them with the default milestone
  -f, --format string              Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down      Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string              Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                      Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration           Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                    Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
